artifact: §4 normative reconstruction from the WRITTEN contract

definitions.evaluationUnit: one ground-truth proposition (caseId) drawn from the frozen adjudication sample; n=47
definitions.credit: creditEligibility=CREDIT iff matchStatus in {EXACT_SINGLE, EXACT_COMPOSITE}; else NO_CREDIT. A direct relabelling of the frozen matcher's outcome, introducing no new judgment.
definitions.noCredit: every other matchStatus, including PARTIAL, UNREPRESENTED, HONESTLY_UNRESOLVED, HONESTLY_UNSUPPORTED, CONTRADICTORY, AMBIGUOUS
definitions.falseCredit: CREDIT awarded where the candidate does not represent the ground-truth proposition; prohibited by the frozen matcher's claim-identity requirement
definitions.surfacing: surfacingStatus=NOT_APPLICABLE when creditEligibility=CREDIT. Otherwise SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED iff the unit's explicitlySurfacedAsUnsafe field is true; else NOT_SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED.
definitions.partial: representationCompleteness=PARTIAL iff matchStatus=PARTIAL. PARTIAL never yields CREDIT.
definitions.ambiguous: matchStatus=AMBIGUOUS maps to representationCompleteness=NONE and creditEligibility=NO_CREDIT
definitions.unsupported: HONESTLY_UNSUPPORTED maps to representationCompleteness=NONE and creditEligibility=NO_CREDIT
definitions.consensus: majority 2-of-3 per case per dimension; a 3-way split is UNRESOLVED_CONSENSUS and excluded from that dimension's denominator (0 occurrences observed)
definitions.denominators: creditEligibility scored over all 47 cases; surfacingStatus scored ONLY over cases where a 2-of-3 majority assigned NO_CREDIT (n=36)

identifiedAmbiguities.statement: The contract does not specify the COVERAGE THRESHOLD for a composite claim. Where a ground-truth proposition spans several sub-provisions and a claim-specific flag attaches to only one of them, the contract does not say whether the composite claim is SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED.
identifiedAmbiguities.whyItMatters: this is the single distinction the three adjudicators resolved differently, and it drives the dominant NOT_SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED vs SPECIFICALLY_SURFACED confusion

identifiedAmbiguities.statement: explicitlySurfacedAsUnsafe is computed only from pairs whose correspondence resolved to CORRESPONDS_FULLY or CORRESPONDS_PARTIALLY. The contract discloses this but does not state whether a human adjudicator should apply the same restriction, so a reviewer may count a DISCOVERY_CANDIDATE or audit finding the machine structurally cannot.
